• (03:47) - The Boomer Put
  • (19:01) - Stripe @ $200b
  • (23:45) - CrowdStrike to Buy ZScaler
  • (28:04) - Iowa Braces For Controlled Blast
  • (30:36) - Microsoft Declares Code Red
  • (32:57) - 𝕏 Timeline Reactions
  • (45:42) - Jason Buechel, CEO of Whole Foods Market and Amazon Worldwide Grocery Stores, discusses his path from a food-focused upbringing and technology career to leading Amazon’s grocery business. He covers Thanksgiving planning, demand forecasting, supply-chain automation, customer service, and the growing role of AI-powered shopping through Alexa.
  • (59:46) - Brian Halligan discusses his return as HubSpot’s co-founder and CEO, driven by the transformative opportunities created by AI. He outlines plans to make HubSpot more accessible through AI agents, accelerate experimentation and acquisitions, and reshape sales and marketing while remaining focused on the CRM market.
  • (01:16:08) - Owen Rapaport & John Harris. Owen Rapaport, a leader at Erebor Bank, discusses the bank’s partnership with Harbinger to finance manufacturing for its $300 million FedEx contract. They explain Erebor’s broader vision of supporting fast-growing American industrial companies with lending and banking products tailored to their expansion. John Harris is the co-founder and CEO of Harbinger Motors, an electric vehicle manufacturer founded in 2021 that builds medium-duty electric trucks and chassis for commercial fleets, delivery vehicles, and recreational vehicles. Previously, he was a principal mechanical engineer at Anduril Industries, where he led the development and mass production of its Sentry Tower system. He also held engineering roles at Boeing, Faraday Future, and Xos Trucks, and holds degrees in mechanical and aerospace engineering from Cornell University.
  • (01:28:51) - John Tesh discusses his path from aspiring musician and expelled college student to broadcaster, composer, and creator of the iconic NBA theme “Roundball Rock.” He reflects on early television production, the evolution of media technology, music rights, creative constraints, and his energetic new album, Epic Christmas.
